characterization_methods.key_findings: No carbides were detected in the Fe-16%Al monocrystal with 45 ppm C after a heat treatment of 14 days at 320 °C.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: specimens etched by an alcoholic 10% nitric acid solution

characterization_methods.key_findings: The rare globular inclusions (up to 30 µm diameter) in the monocrystals were identified as AlN by EDX analysis.

processing_steps.duration: about 12 h (crystal growth with subsequent cooling)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Monocrystals with up to 10 cm length were grown by the Bridgman method (10–15 mm/h pulling rate); the crystal growth with subsequent cooling occurred within a time period of about 12 h. The Fe-16%Al monocrystal (nominal 16 at.% Al, real 16.0 at.%) is one of these monocrystals.

The Fe-16%Al monocrystal with 45 ppm C was heat-treated for 14 days at 320 °C; no carbides were detected after this treatment. Per the experimental section, all heat treatments other than the short (<300 °C) ones were performed with the specimens enclosed in evacuated (10^-6 bar) SiO2 capsules.

samples.aliases: Fe-16%Al monocrystal with 45 ppm C after 14 days at 320 °C

structures.overall_structure: Fe-16%Al monocrystal (45 ppm C) after 14 days at 320 °C: single-phase bcc Fe-Al solid solution (monocrystal, no grain boundaries) containing rare globular AlN inclusions up to 30 µm. No carbides were detected after this heat treatment (unlike polycrystals and the Fe-17%Al monocrystal).

unmapped_findings: Sample composition (Table 1, monocrystal nominal 16 at.% Al): real Al 16.0 at.% (8.4 wt.-%), C 45 wt.ppm, Si 40 wt.ppm, O 60 wt.ppm; the Fe-16%Al monocrystal is (111)-oriented and is one of the monocrystals containing rare globular AlN inclusions up to 30 µm.

The Fe-16%Al monocrystal was studied by microhardness (Fig. 1) and compressive stress-strain (Fig. 2) as a function of prior heat treatment, but no hardness or yield-stress value is reported for the 320 °C/14 d condition specifically; the hardness plot (Fig. 1) lists 320 °C/233 d (a different duration) and 300 °C/14 d instead, so no mechanical property value can be attributed to this 320 °C/14 d sample.

Without heat treatment no carbides were found in all monocrystals, and heat treatment at 320 °C for 14 days produced less carbides without loading (carbides detected in the Fe-17%Al monocrystal with 70 ppm C only when loaded concurrently at 100 MPa).
